name: @openclinxr/factory-station-core
purpose: Station-agnostic half of the factory stations: the Standard Schema catalog all station payloads validate against, the StationRunner port every station implements, the repo-root and blender-spawn helpers stations build on, and the compile-spec payload writer.

exportSummaries.FactoryStationSchema: The shape of one production station's contract: its id, its Standard Schema validator, and the JSON Schemas admin cards are derived from.
exportSummaries.PRODUCTION_STATION_IDS: The catalog itself: every production station id, the schema record keyed by id, and the id list in catalog order.
exportSummaries.ProductionStationId: The shape of one production station's contract: its id, its Standard Schema validator, and the JSON Schemas admin cards are derived from.
exportSummaries.StandardFailureResult: The shape of one production station's contract: its id, its Standard Schema validator, and the JSON Schemas admin cards are derived from.

exportSummaries.StandardResult: The shape of one production station's contract: its id, its Standard Schema validator, and the JSON Schemas admin cards are derived from.
exportSummaries.StationJsonSchema: The shape of one production station's contract: its id, its Standard Schema validator, and the JSON Schemas admin cards are derived from.
exportSummaries.StationPlan: The port every factory_step runner implements: validate a payload, plan a dry run without spawning anything, or run for real.
exportSummaries.StationPlanResult: The port every factory_step runner implements: validate a payload, plan a dry run without spawning anything, or run for real.
exportSummaries.StationPropertySchema: The shape of one production station's contract: its id, its Standard Schema validator, and the JSON Schemas admin cards are derived from.
exportSummaries.StationRunner: The port every factory_step runner implements: validate a payload, plan a dry run without spawning anything, or run for real.
exportSummaries.applyStationPayloadToCompileSpec: Persist a validated station payload onto a compile-node spec.
exportSummaries.factoryStationSchemas: The catalog itself: every production station id, the schema record keyed by id, and the id list in catalog order.
exportSummaries.planFromCatalog: Catalog validate then attach dry-run plan fields.
exportSummaries.productionStationIds: The catalog itself: every production station id, the schema record keyed by id, and the id list in catalog order.
exportSummaries.repoRoot: Workspace root (pnpm-workspace.yaml), found by walking up from this package.
exportSummaries.spawnBlenderProcess: Blender run spawned through the local compute services gate.
